title: game/objectives/<id>.json
description: One objective of the session (CONTENT_PLAN 3.5, C07). Loaded by ObjectiveBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core). A checklist has a title and its steps name nouns; another objective is shown by its objective.<id>.hud line. An order (VILLAGE_PLAN V03) names the NPC the goods are brought to (deliverTo) and the goods (deliver), and has no title and no steps: its one step, delivered, waits for order_delivered at that NPC with the objective's id. An order is given before it counts (issue #54): its NPC offers it when the talk opens and a «sí» takes it, or its lesson reaches lessonStep.

event.description: The event waited for: a world event (WorldEvents), or for a tip start or aimed_npc.

npc.description: The NPC the event must be about (an agent id).

detail.description: The detail the event must have, exactly (item_picked_up and item_crafted: the noun; torch_at_ring: the ring's name).

trigger.description: What the step or tip waits for (CONTENT_PLAN C06).

item.description: An item by the name the save gives it (ItemDefinition).

id.description: The objective's id, the file's name.

title.description: The target-language title of a checklist (Campamento).

id.description: The step's id; the save keys it <objective>.<step>.

noun.description: For a checklist step: the catalogue noun it is about.

label.description: The word the checklist shows, when the noun's lemma or plural is not it.

restore.description: The code hook that works the step out again from a loaded world; the save does not keep the step.

alsoDoneBy.description: The objectives whose progress also completes this one.

onComplete.description: The code hooks run when the objective is completed.

session.description: The play session the objective is shown and counted from (V03); before it the HUD hides it and its steps count nothing. Every session when left out.

deliverTo.description: An order (V03): the NPC the goods are brought to. When the talk opens on it with the goods in the inventory, the NPC takes them, says <npc>.delivered (its thanks; the reward is that line's give_item), order_delivered is logged and the objective is done. With handOver (issue #42) the NPC asks for them first and the learner hands them over in Spanish.

deliver.description: An order's goods: each item (by the name the save gives it) once, and how many.

lesson.description: An order (V13): the lesson that tells it in the three times, with a do step that waits for its delivery. While that lesson is under way before the step, or is about to start at the order's NPC, walking up with the goods does not deliver them, so the plan comes first even for a learner who carries them already.

lessonStep.description: An order with a lesson (issue #54): the step of that lesson at which the NPC asks for the goods. Reaching it gives the order, as a «sí» to the NPC's own offer does. An order is shown, counted and delivered only once given.

nouns.description: The catalogue nouns that name the goods: a hand_over line whose item is one of them hands them over (agua or botella for the bottle of water).

handOver.description: An order the learner hands over in Spanish (issue #42): when the talk opens with the goods, the NPC raises <npc>.order_ready and waits in its receiving state for a hand_over line (Aquí tienes la madera) that names one of the nouns; then it says <npc>.delivered. Two missed lines or «no sé» hand the goods over anyway (rule 8). Without it, walking up with the goods is enough.
